definition_en: the crime of marrying someone while still legally married to another person
core_image: 两本结婚证压在同一张桌上，其中一本注定作废
scene: 两场婚礼的日期只隔了三个月。He was charged with bigamy last spring.
sceneCN: 这里 bigamy 是「重婚罪」（第 1 个义项：已有婚姻时再结婚的罪行）；句意是他去年春天被控重婚。

derivatives.zh: 同族词，义为「一夫一妻制」

senses.title: The crime of a second marriage
senses.definition: the criminal offence of marrying while a previous marriage is still valid
senses.definitionCN: 在前一段婚姻仍有效时再行结婚的刑事罪行
senses.example: He was charged with bigamy last spring.
senses.why: Greek bi- means twice and gamos means marriage; marrying twice at once is the crime.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 bi- 意为「两次」，gamos 意为「婚姻」；同时结两次婚即成罪。

senses.title: The state of having two spouses
senses.definition: the condition of being married to two people at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 同时与两人保持婚姻的状态
senses.example: His bigamy lasted four years before exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 他的重婚状态维持了四年才败露。
senses.why: The act hardens into an ongoing condition.
senses.whyCN: 一次行为凝固为持续的状态。

senses.title: Voidness of the second marriage
senses.definition: the legal nullity that follows when a later marriage overlaps an earlier one
senses.definitionCN: 后一段婚姻与前一段重叠而引致的法律无效
senses.example: Bigamy rendered the second ceremony void from the start.
senses.exampleCN: 重婚使第二场婚礼自始无效。
senses.why: Law erases the overlap it forbids.
senses.whyCN: 法律抹去它所禁止的重叠。

senses.title: Historical church-law sense
senses.definition: in old canon law, a second marriage after widowhood, once a bar to orders
senses.definitionCN: 旧教会法中指丧偶后再婚，曾构成受圣职的障碍
senses.example: Under canon law, bigamy once barred a man from the priesthood.
senses.exampleCN: 依教会法，再婚者曾不得受任圣职。
senses.why: The word's first life was ecclesiastical, not criminal.
senses.whyCN: 该词的第一重生命属教会，而非刑法。

senses.title: Fraud upon the new spouse
senses.definition: the deception practised on the unknowing second partner
senses.definitionCN: 对不知情的后一配偶实施的欺骗
senses.example: The court treated her bigamy as fraud upon the groom.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭认定她的重婚构成对新郎的欺诈。
senses.why: Hiding a marriage is the fraud at the crime's heart.
senses.whyCN: 隐瞒婚姻正是此罪的核心欺诈。

senses.title: Statutory bigamy in different systems
senses.definition: the offence as variously defined across legal systems
senses.definitionCN: 不同法域对重婚罪的界定
senses.example: Bigamy statutes differ on what counts as a valid first marriage.
senses.exampleCN: 各地重婚法对首段婚姻有效性的认定不一。
senses.why: What counts as marriage decides what counts as bigamy.
senses.whyCN: 何谓婚姻，决定何谓重婚。

senses.title: Bigamy by oversight
senses.definition: bigamy committed without knowledge of a still-subsisting marriage
senses.definitionCN: 在不知前婚仍存续时构成的重婚
senses.example: A missing divorce decree turned his remarriage into bigamy.
senses.exampleCN: 一纸遗失的离婚判令让他的再婚成了重婚。
senses.why: The law punishes the fact, whatever the memory.
senses.whyCN: 法律惩罚事实，无论记性如何。

senses.title: Bigamy in social debate
senses.definition: the practice as discussed in debates over marriage law and custom
senses.definitionCN: 婚姻法制与习俗讨论中的重婚现象
senses.example: The essay traces bigamy from church court to family court.
senses.exampleCN: 文章追溯了重婚从宗教法庭到家事法庭的变迁。
senses.why: The word serves history and sociology as well as criminal law.
senses.whyCN: 该词同样服务于历史与社会学。

intro.en: Bigamy joins bi-, two, with Greek gamos, marriage.
intro.cn: bigamy 由 bi-「二」加希腊语 gamos「婚姻」构成。

items.en: gamos meant marriage; digamos meant twice married.
items.cn: 希腊语 gamos 意为「婚姻」；digamos 意为「两度结婚的」。

items.en: bigamus and bigamia passed into Church Latin.
items.cn: bigamus 与 bigamia 进入教会拉丁语。

items.en: canon law used bigamia for second marriage, later narrowed to unlawful second marriage.
items.cn: 教会法以 bigamia 指第二次婚姻，后收窄为非法再婚。

items.en: English took the word with its criminal sense established.
items.cn: 英语借入该词时已是刑事罪名。

items.en: now the standard legal term for unlawful double marriage.
items.cn: 如今是非法双重婚姻的标准法律用语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the gam- marriage root; the near-meaning group gathers marriage-status words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 gam-「婚姻」词根；近义组汇集婚姻状态类词。

entries.definitionCN: 重婚者——bigamy 的施动者名词

entries.definition: the practice of one spouse only
entries.definitionCN: 一夫一妻制——同根 mono-（单一）
婚姻状态——同根 gamos 经拉丁语
不般配的婚姻——与罪行无关

normalIntro.cn: bigamy 是 bi-（二）加 gamos（婚姻）。

normal.en: Canon law once used it differently.

abstract.en: See one registrar stamping a certificate twice.
abstract.cn: 看登记员在同一张证书上盖了两次章。

abstract.en: Feel the second vow collapse on the first.
abstract.cn: 感受第二个誓词压塌在第一个之上。

abstract.en: Picture two families meeting by accident.
abstract.cn: 想象两个家庭不期而遇。

examples.en: He was charged with bigamy last spring.
Bigamy rendered the second ceremony void from the start.
examples.cn: 重婚使第二场婚礼自始无效。

examples.en: A missing divorce decree turned his remarriage into bigamy.
examples.cn: 一纸遗失的离婚判令让他的再婚成了重婚。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必·盖媒」——必得盖住前一个媒证才敢再婚，盖不住即成重婚。

root: 拉丁语 bi-「二」加希腊语 gamos「婚姻」复合为教会拉丁语 bigamia「第二次婚姻」，后收窄为非法再婚；英语于中古时期承其刑事义，现代为重婚罪标准用语，同根词有 monogamy、polygamy、matrimony。

sensesIntro.en: From twice-married the word grows crime, voidness, fraud, and old church law.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「两度结婚」长出罪行、无效、欺诈与旧教会法诸义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two valid-looking vows, only one legal
core.cn: 核心意象：两份看似有效的誓词，只有一份合法

intro.en: Bigamy is a Greek number-marriage compound via Latin.
intro.cn: bigamy 是经拉丁语传入的希腊「数词加婚姻」复合词。

latinIntro.en: The gamos family in Greek and its Latin-English heirs.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 gamos 词族及其拉丁、英语后裔。
